title: The phone's What's new tells every member about the watch app, but the watch app is only on Google Play's test tracks
what: The phone app every member gets from Google Play shows What's new lines such as 'New: the MettleUp watch app', 'log each set with the dial', 'tap Install on watch' and 'your watch screen now stays on'. The watch app itself has no production release on Play: only testers can install it. A member who reads these lines and looks for the watch app finds nothing. An older entry's own note already says the watch app is testers only.
expected: What's new names watch features only to members who can get the watch app, or the watch app is released to everyone first.
how_often: every member who reads What's new
fix_line: Release the watch app to production on Play, or hide the watch lines from members outside the test groups until then

title: Closed watch testers still get the old watch app that hides itself from the phone; the fixed one waits for Publish
what: The closed test group for the watch still gets version 0.78.0. In that version the watch never tells the phone it is installed, so the phone treats the watch as one without MettleUp: the 'watch update ready' notice never shows and the phone offers to install an app that is already there. Version 0.79.0 fixes this and the big numbers at the largest text size; it was approved on 17 Nov but nobody pressed Publish, so only the small internal group has it.
expected: The closed watch testers get the same fixed watch version as the internal group, as approved on 17 Nov.
how_often: every closed tester with the watch app
fix_line: Press Publish on the approved 0.79.0 watch release for the closed track

title: The feature list calls 20 watch features live, but only testers can install the watch app
what: The feature list marks 20 of the 24 watch features as live and 4 as behind a switch. On Google Play the watch app has internal and closed test releases and no production release, so for members these features are not live at all. Two of the four 'behind a switch' marks are also wrong the other way: the exercise-done and 'not saved' screens follow a flag that every current phone app sends as on, so they are on wherever the watch app is.
expected: The watch features read 'testers only' until the watch app is in production, and the exercise-done and 'not saved' screens read live with watch logging.
who: the owner reading the feature map
how_often: every time the map is read
fix_line: Mark the watch features testers only and the two logging screens live, in the feature list
